issue.title: NETWORKING: Fix Netty Leaks by upgrading to 4.1.28

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
* Upgrade to `4.1.28` since the problem reported in #32487  is a bug in Netty itself (see https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/7337)
* Fixed other leaks in test code that now showed up due to fixes improvements in leak reporting in the newer version
* Needed to extend permissions for netty common package because it now sets a classloader at runtime after changes in https://github.com/netty/netty/commit/63bae0956aeb42e875ad303a2281989ad92acbf2
* Adjusted forbidden APIs check accordingly
* Closes #32487
